title: Contrix Bottom Diagnostics
description: Structured diagnostic for cell join values that resolve to bottom (⊥). Surfaced on /sync, /events, and state query responses when a cell's effective Lattice value is undefined under the current Anchor view. See spec/v1/zh/authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md §5.1.

kind.description: Why the join produced bottom. 'conflict' = concurrent cas-register / fsm divergence on safety-critical cell. 'invalid_transition' = fsm op violates allowed_transitions. 'missing_dependency' = Move ref to absent / failed prior Move. 'unauthorized' = Move issuer lacks capability for the op (verifier-side). 'anchorer_split' = multiple anchorer cell Anchor leaves diverge on next-batch authority. 'schema_error' = lattice op or value violates declared cell schema.

cells.description: Cell ids participating in the bottom diagnostic. Multi-cell when a multi-cell Move atomically failed across linked cells.

move_ids.description: Anchored Move ids whose effects (or precondition checks) produced this bottom. Empty allowed when the cell's bottom is structural (e.g. anchorer cell schema_error) and not tied to a specific Move.

anchor_view.description: Anchor leaves and frontier under which this bottom was observed. Diagnostics MUST pin this so the receiver can reproduce the join without ambiguity.

state_root.description: Effective anchor view state_root at observation time (recompute from leaves). Optional when the diagnostic is emitted before state_root is computable.

heads.description: When kind=conflict and the cell's lattice exposes multiple candidate heads (mv-register, or-set with conflicting tag values), the candidate values. Implementations MUST NOT pick a winner from this array; it is for UI / audit only.

details.description: Free-form structured details specific to the diagnostic kind. Producers SHOULD use stable keys per kind (e.g. invalid_transition: from/to/expected_transitions; schema_error: schema_id/violation_path). Receivers MAY display but MUST NOT use for authorization decisions.

escalated_at.description: When the cell first crossed Space.bottom_escalation_after_ms. Absent when within the grace window. Implementations SHOULD raise an out-of-band notification to admins / recovery governance once set.
